# GeeksforGeeks

> > A comprehensive computer science learning portal offering tutorials, interview preparation, and hands-on practice for programming languages (Python, Java, C++, JavaScript), data structures & algorithms, web development, and machine learning.

GeeksforGeeks is an all-in-one educational platform founded by Sandeep Jain, providing free tutorials, coding practice, and career preparation resources. The site covers everything from programming fundamentals to advanced topics in DevOps, cloud computing (AWS), and modern frameworks (React, Next.js, Django, Node.js).

## Key Topics

- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- Python, Java, C++, C, JavaScript
- Interview Preparation
- Web Development (HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS)
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- Machine Learning & Data Science
- Backend Development (Node.js, Django, Spring Boot)
- Standard Template Library (STL)
- Memory Management
- Computer Fundamentals & Architecture
- DevOps & Cloud Computing (AWS)
- Programming Tutorials for Beginners
- Linux & Windows Operating Systems
- Modern Frameworks (React, Next.js)
- API Development (REST, GraphQL, gRPC)

## Core Learning Portal

- [GeeksforGeeks | Your All-in-One Learning Portal](https://gdevtest.geeksforgeeks.org): Main learning portal homepage for DSA, programming, and interview prep
- [GeeksforGeeks Online Tutorials - FREE!](https://geeksforgeeks.org/gfg-academy/geeksforgeeks-online-tutorials-free): Free tutorial library for DSA, web dev, data science, and ML
- [GeeksforGeeks IDE Portal](https://ide.geeksforgeeks.org): IDE portal for coding practice and programming tutorials
- [About GeeksforGeeks](https://geeksforgeeks.org/about): Company profile, mission, and founder Sandeep Jain's story

## Programming Languages

- [Programming Languages Tutorials](https://geeksforgeeks.org/tutorials/programming-language-tutorials): Comprehensive tutorials for C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript & more
- [Python Tutorial](https://geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-programming-language-tutorial): Complete Python tutorial covering basics, libraries, and applications
- [C++ Programming Language](https://geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/c-plus-plus): C++ tutorial with OOP, STL, memory management, and examples
- [Java Tutorial](https://geeksforgeeks.org/java/java): Java tutorial covering JVM, OOP, Spring, Hibernate, and Android
- [C Programming Tutorial](https://geeksforgeeks.org/c/c-programming-language): C programming guide by Dennis Ritchie, covering UNIX and fundamentals
- [Introduction to C++](https://geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/cpp-programming-intro): C++ intro by Bjarne Stroustrup: first program and STL basics

## Data Structures & Algorithms

- [Learn DSA in C](https://geeksforgeeks.org/c/learn-dsa-in-c): DSA tutorial using C: data structures, algorithms, memory management
- [Pointers vs References in C++](https://geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/pointers-vs-references-cpp): C++ pointers vs references: memory addressing and dereferencing

## Computer Science Fundamentals

- [Programming Tutorial | Introduction & Basic Concepts](https://geeksforgeeks.org/computer-science-fundamentals/programming-tutorial): Programming basics: variables, control flow, functions, first code
- [Computer Fundamentals Tutorial](https://geeksforgeeks.org/computer-science-fundamentals/computer-fundamentals-tutorial): Basic to advanced concepts: hardware, software, OS, and peripherals
- [Basics of Computer and its Operations](https://geeksforgeeks.org/computer-science-fundamentals/basics-of-computer-and-its-operations): Computer fundamentals: hardware, software, CPU, and operations
- [What is a Computer?](https://geeksforgeeks.org/computer-organization-architecture/a-simple-understanding-of-computer): Computer basics: types, CPU architecture, and connectivity

## Web Development & Modern Frameworks

- [Create FAQs using React and Tailwind CSS](https://geeksforgeeks.org/reactjs/create-faqs-using-react-and-tailwind-css): React FAQ component with Tailwind CSS and toggle functionality
- [Create FAQs using Next.js and Tailwind CSS](https://geeksforgeeks.org/nextjs/create-faqs-using-next-js-and-tailwind-css): Next.js FAQ section with Tailwind CSS and collapsible answers
- [How to create an FAQ section using JavaScript](https://geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/how-to-create-an-faq-section-to-any-website-using-javascript): JavaScript accordion FAQ with DOM manipulation and event listeners
- [How to create a FAQ page using JavaScript](https://geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/how-to-create-a-faq-page-using-javascript): Interactive FAQ page with expand/collapse using JavaScript
- [How to create a FAQ Section in Bootstrap](https://geeksforgeeks.org/bootstrap/how-to-create-a-faq-section-in-bootstrap): Bootstrap 5 accordion component for collapsible FAQ sections

## Career & Interview Preparation

- [60 Days of Backend Development: A Complete Guide](https://geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/60-days-of-backend-development): 60-day roadmap covering Spring Boot, Django, Laravel, Node.js
- [A Comprehensive Guide to API Development](https://geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/a-comprehensive-guide-to-api-development): API development guide covering REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and gRPC
- [Complete Interview Preparation With Doubt Assistance](https://geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/complete-interview-preparation-with-doubt-assistance-get-your-every-question-answered): Interview prep course with mentorship and doubt assistance
